newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, latex weak.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, latex weak.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading on Monday despite a lack of demand, while latex remained weak, dealers said.
"The market has stayed so quiet with no fresh deals heard. Supply is still tight but demand is so weak," one dealer in the north Sumatran city of Medan said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries were at 57.00-57.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 56.50-57.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.25-56.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
SIR20 was last heard traded at 56.75 cents/lb fob Medan late on Friday, with offtakes in small quantity, dealers said.
They said prices were likely to be stuck in a narrow range in the coming days, despite the apparent tight supply, due to expected weak demand.
Latex dealers said reports that large state-owned plantation firm PTPN VIII had sold 500 tonnes of latex at 2,230 rupiah/kg for September deliveries further dampened sentiment.
Latex was previously traded at 2,250 rupiah/kg in the west Java town of Bandung, they said.
